verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an API endpoint to start an automation for a specific contact. That shows EmailOctopus has its own automation feature, but it describes a programmatic one-off trigger rather than user-defined event rules that fire automatically. missing for 10: documentation of event-based triggers (e.g. subscribe, click, tag), rule or condition definition, available actions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Start an automation for a specific contact.
